normal_sequence: result publication and group completion notification
core+0x258 cleanup releases job argument and clears cleanup pointer

group_completion_registration.effect: unlink matching Job node and release strong pair

executor_closure.disposal: inline/heap destructor releases core strong pair

queued_signal.job_argument: raw pointer at +0x60; no additional job control pair

base_cleanup: job+0x18 base removes recorded connections then destroys its mutex

adapter_constraints: Keep service/request ownership independent of Job/Core scope.
Do not add a strong callback capture of its own Job.
External Job copies delay final function capture destruction after core exit.
Executor closure disposal and core return are separate from result readiness.
Do not manually run core cleanup or destructors to force the last release.
